title: Security gate and operating workflow
pretest_endpoint: All required S04.01-.10, S05.01-.06, both rollback artifacts, fixtures, scope and documentation together.
check_policy: No tests, checks, verification or review until full combined implementation is complete.
authority_scope: Explicit owner approval of the two source batches and provisional sequencing only.
prior_context: Copied S00-S03 is read-only context, never replacement payload.

original_tasks.title: Stage acquisition separately from analysis
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: update-manifest.json with approved binary/rule/database identities, verification evidence and previous approved set.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Reject mutable/unverified artifacts; network acquisition is separately authorized and cannot run inside analysis.

original_tasks.title: Define dataset freshness and failure semantics
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Per-dataset freshness deadlines, acquisition-failure/expired/absent/unsupported states and visible rollback metadata.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Old verified data may support a labelled partial result but cannot masquerade as current vulnerability intelligence.

original_tasks.title: Automate the already-qualified offline profile
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Hardened execution orchestration preserving S01 egress, resource, output, environment and socket boundaries.
original_tasks.done_evidence: No automatic package install; S04 does not postpone the isolation required before S03 scans.

original_tasks.title: Deduplicate without deleting independent evidence
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Stable fingerprints and first/current/resolution records with linked detector-specific confirmations.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Matching findings aggregate while conflicting evidence, distinct observations and independent confirmations remain attributable.

original_tasks.title: Implement owned expiring suppressions and exceptions
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Suppression ledger with reason, authorized owner, exact scope, expiry and trusted external policy hash.
original_tasks.done_evidence: No self-waiver or score-driven suppression; candidate changes cannot silently change current acceptance.

original_tasks.title: Parse scanner output as bounded untrusted data
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Schema-validated parsing with field/size bounds and no remote schema resolution.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Malformed, oversized or unknown output records failure/partial state without executing content or discarding required coverage.

original_tasks.title: Render inert secret-safe reports
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Contextually escaped Markdown/HTML; unsafe executable links, raw HTML, scripts, handlers and fetched assets prohibited.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Findings, paths and rule text are inert, bounded data; no raw secrets, remote contact or execution on opening.

original_tasks.title: Emit the combined evidence reports
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Combined OCR/security JSON, Markdown and HTML with pins, coverage, findings, errors and unrun checks.
original_tasks.done_evidence: No automatic upload; raw output stays local/access-controlled and published reports contain only sanitized evidence.

original_tasks.title: Implement optional supported SARIF interchange
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Sanitized SARIF exporter only for a confirmed receiving-tool contract selected before freeze.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Interchange preserves findings/coverage meaning and never uploads to GitHub code scanning without a distinct authorized action.
original_tasks.condition: SARIF output is selected before S04 freeze and the receiving tool supports the verified schema

original_tasks.title: Implement fail-closed target acceptance
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Evaluator emits pass/with-findings/incomplete/error/not-run under current approved findings/exception policy.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Skipped/stale/partial/exit-zero/error/missing-review results cannot pass; unresolved blocking findings require authorized scoped resolution/exception.

original_tasks.title: Implement distinct harness qualification and regressions
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Expected-positive/negative qualification evaluator plus stale, partial, hostile-report and candidate-policy regression fixtures.
original_tasks.done_evidence: A detector passes by finding a seeded defect, while target acceptance for that vulnerable fixture stays blocked; fixtures authored, not executed.

original_tasks.title: Accept the qualified sprint or retain an explicit hold
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Independent sprint_qualification decision and five stage states; separate target acceptance.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Complete only with actual current full review, verified preservation and all applicable checks passed; otherwise unchecked (C05).

original_tasks.title: Resolve supported findings and seal review outcome
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Coherent corrections with independent re-review, or review-pending preservation receipt.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Final hash and dispositions agree; incomplete review never becomes clean (C03).

original_tasks.title: Freeze the complete sprint scope
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Frozen scope, owners, allowed actions, selected/deferred work and endpoint.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Dependencies resolved and validation plan fixed before implementation; C01–C02 apply.

original_tasks.title: Seal the full implementation endpoint
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Exact diff/file-hash freeze and implementation checklist.
original_tasks.done_evidence: All required/selected implementation and fixture artifacts exist; no sprint tests/scans have run (C02).

conditional_dependencies.when: SARIF output is selected before S04 freeze and the receiving tool supports the verified schema

original_tasks.title: Preserve eligible source immediately in the same draft
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Root-verified remote repository/branch/commit/tree and same-draft PR receipt.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Eligible source saved immediately, labelled untested/review-pending; held payloads stay separate (C03, C07).

original_tasks.title: Record independent full-diff review
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Different-context OCR/security outcome and full coverage receipt.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Exact input, missing/surface/unsupported content and actual result recorded; unavailable review stays pending (C03).

original_tasks.title: Write the bounded rollback procedure
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Runbook: Retain prior verified tool/data manifests and reports, mark stale intelligence/incomplete coverage and withhold target acceptance until corrected.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Exact reversible steps, retained evidence and resulting coverage state documented.

original_tasks.title: Preserve validation results and reviewed corrections
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Sanitized validation matrix and independently reviewed correction/evidence preservation receipts.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Remote head/hashes match; failures, skips and unrun checks retained; changed scope has current review. Unavailable checks do not hold existing evidence (C02, C05).
original_tasks.outcome_receipt_semantics: Requires current outcomes, including exact blocked/skipped/unrun/deferred receipts, not successful completion of validation boxes.

original_tasks.title: Verify controlled updates and truthful stale rollback
original_tasks.input: Full sprint endpoint and verified preservation receipt; exact permission for this check
original_tasks.output: Mutable/unverified acquisition rejection, dataset age, missing DB and prior-approved-set receipts.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Rollback remains visible; unavailable acquisition cannot be labelled a clean security scan.

original_tasks.title: Verify deduplication and suppression authority
original_tasks.input: Full sprint endpoint and verified preservation receipt; exact permission for this check
original_tasks.output: Multi-detector, conflicting-evidence, expired/wrong-scope exception and candidate-weakened-policy results.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Provenance retained; unauthorized suppressions do not clear findings.

original_tasks.title: Verify hostile reports stay inert and usable
original_tasks.input: Full sprint endpoint and verified preservation receipt; exact permission for this check
original_tasks.output: Authorized local rendering cases containing markup, unsafe links, control characters, oversized fields and synthetic secrets.
original_tasks.done_evidence: No script, remote request or disclosure; readable desktop/mobile/print output and exact JSON/Markdown/HTML parity. If S04.08S was selected, also validate SARIF locally against the pinned receiving schema and verify finding identity/severity/location/coverage semantics, redaction and no upload. An unrun/unsupported selected format remains incomplete and cannot qualify; an unselected SARIF branch is explicitly not applicable. Unavailable rendering stays unverified.

original_tasks.title: Verify qualification cannot clear a vulnerable target
original_tasks.input: Full sprint endpoint and verified preservation receipt; exact permission for this check
original_tasks.output: Positive/negative and exit-zero/partial/stale/missing-review acceptance matrix.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Qualification and actual target states differ correctly; all unknown or blocking coverage failures fail closed.

original_tasks.title: Write the full-sprint operator workflow
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: WORKFLOW.md and scoped AGENTS integration proposal express implementation → independent review/fixes → immediate same-draft preservation → permitted checks → preserved evidence.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Untested source is labelled; proposal does not itself change live AGENTS, scheduler, hooks or CI.

original_tasks.title: Implement preservation and acceptance as separate outcomes
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Review-pending/failure/held-path receipts and root handoff for eligible source preservation.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Review failure cannot strand all source or become clean; exact denial/uncertain action is not automatically retried.

original_tasks.title: Track whole-PR distinct paths and dependent batches
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: 200–300 distinct-path ledger with coherent next-sprint fit, no-padding and smaller-boundary reasons.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Below 200 advances eligible work; over-cap coherent scope goes to dependent draft; source preservation never waits for filler.

original_tasks.title: Track one consolidated CodeRabbit review
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Current-head coverage, completed/automatic/in-flight/uncertain request ledger and exactly-one-review intent/response record.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Only root may request; reconcile at final freeze, no preservation trigger lookup or per-sprint/manual duplicate request.

original_tasks.title: Represent merge conflicts and exact action gates
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Root-only publish/request/merge decisions tied to current change, permissions and mandatory repository checks.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Current-head review conflict after correction is surfaced without another intentional review, changed protections or paid capacity.

original_tasks.title: Author coordinator event fixtures
original_tasks.input: Approved frozen scope, shared contract and named dependencies
original_tasks.output: Synthetic review failure, preservation failure, uncertain publication, duplicate review and completed-batch transitions.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Fixtures represent root actions without real pushes, requests, merges or scheduler/CI edits.

original_tasks.output: Synthetic review/preservation failure, cancelled/denied and uncertain-send event receipts.
original_tasks.done_evidence: Eligible source is handed to root promptly; uncertain outcomes reconcile before repeat; held paths never hide in larger payloads.
